data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Check my bus → Track my bus → Service Number tab → type number), but it adds an unobserved "city" parameter, a conditional city step and a "Find my bus" click, and it omits the suggestion/submit step, so an automation built from it would be somewhat ambiguous.
